claimText: NASA confirmed the Earth will experience 3 days of complete darkness in December

brave.title: NASA debunks 'Three Days of Darkness' hoax
brave.description: NASA has confirmed that there is no astronomical event that would cause three days of darkness. This is a recurring internet hoax that resurfaces every few months.

brave.title: Snopes: Will the Earth experience three days of complete darkness?
brave.description: This claim has been circulating since at least 2014. NASA and other space agencies have repeatedly confirmed no such event is possible or predicted.

brave.title: AFP Fact Check: No, NASA did not predict 3 days of darkness
brave.description: Social media posts falsely claim NASA confirmed Earth will experience three days of complete darkness. NASA has made no such announcement.

brave.title: USA Today Fact Check: Three days of darkness claim is a hoax
brave.description: Experts confirm there is no scientific basis for the claim that Earth will go dark for three days. The hoax has been debunked multiple times.

claimReviewMarkup.title: No, NASA did not predict three days of darkness
